master.definition_en: A rare neuropsychiatric disorder whose primary feature is the delusion that relatives or close acquaintances are not the persons that they are known to be. master.definition_en: An acute exacerbation of asthma, characterized by inadequate response to initial bronchodilators.

curated.name_zh: 重症哮喘持续状态与急性气道梗阻
curated.name_en: Status Asthmaticus and Acute Airway Obstruction
aliases_zh: 急性重度气道痉挛梗阻
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 常规支气管舒张剂难以缓解的致死性支气管痉挛或急性上/下气道梗阻，数分钟至数小时内即可因严重低氧血症、高碳酸血症酸中毒、气胸或窒息导致心跳呼吸骤停。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 院前及急诊数分钟内迅速解痉、全身激素抗炎、解除梗阻及无创/有创通气可挽救绝大部分患者生命；出院后须转向哮喘长期规范控制以防再发。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO全球死因统计不单列“哮喘持续状态”，其急性致死归入支气管哮喘死亡口径（2023年全球哮喘死亡约442,000例；GBD 2021约为436,000例）。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 国家层面归入哮喘死亡统计（GBD 2021中国哮喘死亡约26,233例）；香港PICU 16年队列显示哮喘持续状态占PICU收治约2.4%，约10%因严重呼吸性酸中毒（低pH）需行气管插管有创机械通气；重症机械通气期国际规范通常采用允许性高碳酸血症策略（维持动脉pH>7.20），严防过度通气诱发动态肺过度充气与气压伤。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球约3.63亿哮喘患者中部分控制不良或遭遇过敏原/病毒触发者可突发危重持续状态。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国成人哮喘约4,570万人，长期控制率偏低使基层及急诊科急性重度发作仍较常见。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 即刻高流量吸氧维持SpO2 93%–95%；连续或高频雾化吸入短效β2受体激动剂（SABA，如特布他林/沙丁胺醇）联合异丙托溴铵；尽早静脉推注或口服全身糖皮质激素（如甲泼尼龙/氢化可的松）；难治性危重病例静脉输注硫酸镁（2g静滴），合并过敏性休克/喉头水肿者即刻肌注肾上腺素；出现意识障碍、“沉默肺”、严重呼吸性酸中毒或低氧即刻气管插管机械通气（低呼吸频率、长呼气时间防内源性PEEP与气压伤）；怀疑异物/肿瘤致机械性急性气道梗阻则立即行海姆立克急救或急诊支气管镜解除梗阻。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 以奥马珠单抗、度普利尤单抗、美泊利珠单抗及本瑞利珠单抗等生物制剂作为“预防性上游拦截”大幅减少难治性哮喘进入危重持续状态的机会；吸入糖皮质激素/长效β2激动剂（ICS-福莫特罗）作为抗炎缓解疗法纳入全球哮喘防治创议（GINA）首选，显著降低了急诊与死亡风险。

master.definition_en: A differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from the follicular cells of the thyroid gland. Radiation exposure is a risk factor and it is the most common malignant thyroid lesion, comprising 75% to 80% of all thyroid cancers in iodine sufficient countries. Diagnostic procedures include thyroid ultrasound and fine needle biopsy. Microscopically, the diagnosis is based on the distinct characteristics of the malignant cells, which include enlargement, oval shape, elongation, and overlapping of the nuclei. The nuclei also display clearing or have a ground glass appearance.
synonyms_en: papillary cancer of the thyroid gland
papillary carcinoma of the thyroid gland

master.definition_en: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy is a reversible form of cholestasis that occurs most often in the third trimester of pregnancy and recurs in 45 to 70% of subsequent pregnancies. Symptoms include pruritus, jaundice, increased serum bile salts, and abnormal liver enzymes, all of which resolve rapidly after delivery. However, the condition is associated with fetal complications, including placental insufficiency, premature labor, fetal distress, and intrauterine death. Women with ICP are also susceptible to oral contraceptive-induced cholestasis (OCIC). Ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) is an effective treatment for conditions caused by ABCB4 mutations (summary by Pasmant et al., 2012).

master.definition_en: A rare developmental defect with connective tissue involvement disorder characterized by tall stature, inguinal hernia, facial dysmorphism (including a long, triangular face, prominent forehead, telecanthus, downslanting palpebral fissures, bilateral ptosis, everted lower eyelids, large ears, long nose, full, everted vermilions, narrow and high arched palate, dental crowding), and radiologic evidence of advanced bone age. Additional manifestations include hyperextensible joints, long digits, mild muscle weakness, myopia, and foot deformities (i.e. hallux valgus, talipes equinovarus).

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: Woolly hair nevus (WHN) is a rare non-familial hair anomaly characterized by kinky, tightly coiled, and hypopigmented fine hair with an average diameter of 0.5 cm, noted, since birth or during the first two years of life, in a localized circumscribed distribution on the scalp. Occasionally, WHN grows in areas observed to be alopecic in the neonatal period. WHN can be associated with features like ocular defects (persistent pupillary membrane, retinal defects), precocious puberty, and epidermal nevi.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号

master.definition_en: A rare epidermal disease characterized by the association of punctate acrokeratoderma with a pigmentary disorder. Patients present skin-colored keratotic papules on the hands and feet and pronounced hyperkeratosis of the palms and soles. Freckle-like pigmentation on the dorsal surfaces of the hands and feet is also reported. Histological examination reveals no fragmentation of dermal elastic tissue. There have been no further descriptions in the literature since 1993.

master.definition_en: Cardiac manifestation of gastrointestinal CARCINOID TUMOR that metastasizes to the liver. Substances secreted by the tumor cells, including SEROTONIN, promote fibrous plaque formation in ENDOCARDIUM and its underlying layers. These deposits cause distortion of the TRICUSPID VALVE and the PULMONARY VALVE eventually leading to STENOSIS and valve regurgitation.

master.definition_en: An instance of prostate cancer that is caused by an inherited genomic modification in an individual. Familial prostate cancer (FPC) is a malignant tumor of the prostate with an early onset. FPC is either asymptomatic or causes mictionary symptoms, erectile dysfunction, bone pain, venous compression and infectious or inflammatory syndrome (for the metastatic forms). It is also characterized by familial antecedents.

master.definition_en: A rare lung condition characterized by often predominantly unilateral lung hyperlucency and air trapping. The condition is a post-infectious form of bronchiolitis obliterans and typically follows a viral respiratory infection in infancy and childhood. Adenovirus infection is considered the most usual epidemiology. In SJS, the involved lung or portion of the lung does not grow normally and is slightly smaller than the opposite lung: in particular, peripheral branches of the pulmonary vessels do not develop, and vasculature is arreseted at the stage at which the infection occurred. Patients respond well to management with bronchodilators, even though this is not primarily a bronchial abnormality.
